No name-only qualification from Berserker Brew, Mooncursed, a prestige lineage or a damage buff. While in an actual acquired Berserker rage, replace its+2 melee bonus with+3 on melee weapon attacks; for any other qualifying rage lacking that+2, NEW grant+3flat melee-weapon damage as this feat's own family, without replacing separately rolled dice. Do not add+3 on top of the same Berserker+2. Berserker Rage CF-03 is an operating rage once this feat was legally acquired by its printed prerequisite, but not an acquisition substitute. Once per turn after your melee attack reduces an independent meaningful hostile from positiveHP to0, choose EITHER one immediate additional melee attack (NEW only on your own turn) OR extend that same currently active rage's time endpoint by one original6second round. Extra attack requires real reach/target/weapon/capability and creates no Action/BA; shared causal limits prevent drop-trigger attack chains. NEW at most three time extensions per single rage use; non-time endings such as incapacitation or missing upkeep remain. Once per rage, on your turn spend BA to charge along a declared straight legal route with a separate current walking-Speed movement-cost budget, through at most three hostile creatures no more than one size larger. Recheck a complete legal unoccupied endpoint before starting, pay occupied-space difficult cost and normal hazards/opportunity attacks. Each crossed creature once makesCON save DC8+PB+STR; failure applies Dazed until its next future original regular end. No damage/Prone/push is implied. If the route is interrupted, stop in the last legal space; already crossed targets remain affected and use stays spent. It cannot force passage when there is no legal complete crossing route.

completeCredentialContracts.completeOperativeProcedure:
Retain CHA15 and an actual already established worship-of-a-deity credential without selecting a new deity or interpreting doctrine here. NEW once per beneficial Long Rest, after your own actual saving throw or ability check is called for, or after its result is known but before its consequences commit, declare this feat to replace that one outcome with ordinary Success. No Action, component or new roll is required; it can protect a living incapacitated creature making an actual save, including a death save. It cannot act after death or reverse committed harm. Fixed-DC task outcome becomes Success, not Critical Success; saves become successful without a natural face or a success-by-margin value. A death save gains one ordinary success, not natural20healing. For a genuinely authorized crafting completion check, this means Standard success in that craft procedure, retaining all work/material/access requirements and any independently reviewed quality adjustment.

For your side of an actual opposed ability check, NEW it wins against an ordinary rolled opponent regardless of total. If both sides commit an explicit automatic-success effect to the same opposition, resolve their incompatible claims by preserving the existing state, as with the Core initiating-tie rule; no retroactive transfer of an already resolved result. This declared conflict rule needs joint review. The feat does not create an ability check when none is allowed, overcome physical impossibility, convert an attack into a check, grant NPC consent outside a legitimately established social success outcome, or grant knowledge unavailable to the legal task. Only one check/save is affected; another save from the same damage event remains separate. Other outcome-triggered rules see ordinary Success, no natural20/1 and no invented numerical margin.

originalObject.name: Berserker
originalObject.description: You can enter a battle rage.
originalObject.effect: Once per long rest, you can rage for 1 minute, gaining +2 damage on melee attacks and resistance to physical damage.

completeBerserkerParent.additionalUniversalAcquisitionGate: One actual unspent class-scheduled ASI/feat opportunity or separately authorized feat grant; prerequisite success never creates a choice.
completeBerserkerParent.completeOperativeProcedure: NEW: as a Bonus Action, spend the feat's one long-rest use to enter this feat rage for one elapsed minute. Gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage, whether magical or nonmagical, and add 2 damage on each actual successful melee attack you own. The melee scope includes weapon, unarmed, natural and melee spell attacks; it is not limited to weapons. Add the flat 2 once to the attack's primary damage type before target defenses; it is not doubled by a critical hit and is not a separate hit, copied damage or spellcasting trigger. NEW: the rage ends early if you voluntarily end it as a Bonus Action or become Incapacitated. It does not require attacking or taking damage to continue, prohibit spellcasting/concentration, extend through repeated attacks, or grant unstated class rage features. Another real rage may coexist under its own rules, but same-scope resistance does not stack and bonuses obey their actual families; this feat's flat rider cannot be counted twice under aliases. A completed rest restores the use, not an encounter declaration.
